email_subject: Application - Jr. UI Developer at RainFocus
email_body:
Dear RainFocus Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Jr. UI Developer role. Your focus on building user-friendly web applications for global events resonates with my background in front-end development and web design.

In my freelance work, I designed and built baverok.com with a hand-coded landing page featuring a WebGL hero, accessible markup, and structured data. I also built mirook.com, implementing JSON-LD schema and running technical audits. Previously, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized features using AngularJS and JavaScript. I'm comfortable with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I'm eager to deepen my skills in SASS, React, and Svelte.

I thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy troubleshooting UI issues across browsers. I'm proactive about learning and asking questions to grow as a developer.

I'd welcome the chance to contribute to RainFocus's innovative platform. Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear RainFocus Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Jr. UI Developer position at RainFocus. Your mission to elevate attendee experiences through innovative event software aligns perfectly with my passion for creating visually engaging and user-friendly web applications.

In my current freelance role, I designed and built baverok.com from scratch using WordPress and Elementor, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, and accessible markup. I also developed mirook.com, where I implemented JSON-LD schema and ran technical audits to improve search health. These projects honed my skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and taught me the importance of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility.

Previously, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. This experience gave me a solid foundation in writing clean, maintainable code and collaborating with a team to deliver quality work. I'm now eager to apply these skills to a role focused on UI development and to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte under experienced guidance.

I'm particularly drawn to RainFocus's collaborative culture and the opportunity to work on enterprise-grade software for Fortune 500 clients. I'm a proactive learner who asks questions and seeks feedback to improve. While I haven't used SASS professionally, I have a strong grasp of CSS fundamentals and am confident I can quickly pick it up. I'm also familiar with version control using Git and have exposure to design tools like Canva, which I believe will help me contribute to your team's design-to-code workflow.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background and enthusiasm can contribute to RainFocus's continued success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
